description: This PHP source file defines the `WorkShiftAPI` class, which provides REST API endpoints for managing work shifts within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for listing, retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting work shift records, along with validation rules and detailed doc-comments describing API behavior. The class leverages various traits, models, and validation mechanisms specific to the system.

classes.name: WorkShiftAPI
classes.description: A REST API endpoint class for managing work shifts, including listing, retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting shift records, with validation rules and detailed API documentation.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list all work shifts with optional sorting and pagination.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific work shift by ID.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new work shift based on provided parameters and employee numbers.

methods.description: Sets properties of a WorkShift entity from request parameters.

methods.description: Updates an existing work shift identified by ID with new parameters.

methods.description: Provides validation rules for updating a work shift, including uniqueness validation.

methods.name: delete
